parameters.query: SELECT pokemon_id, name FROM pokemon ORDER BY random() LIMIT 1;

parameters.jsCode: const crypto=require('crypto');const pick=$('Choisir un pokemon').item.json;const d=$json;const ts=$now.toFormat('yyyyLLdd-HHmmss');const raw=JSON.stringify(d,null,2);const types=(d.types||[]).map(t=>t.type.name).join('/');const stats=(d.stats||[]).map(s=>s.stat.name+'='+s.base_stat).join(';');const img=d.sprites&&d.sprites.other&&d.sprites.other['official-artwork']?d.sprites.other['official-artwork'].front_default:(d.sprites?d.sprites.front_default:'');const nl=String.fromCharCode(10);const csv=['pokemon_id,name,types,height,weight,stats',[pick.pokemon_id,pick.name,types,d.height,d.weight,stats].join(',')].join(nl)+nl;return {json:{pokemon_id:pick.pokemon_id,pokemon_name:pick.name,ts:ts,raw_content:raw,raw_name:pick.name+'-'+ts+'.json',raw_key:pick.pokemon_id+'/'+pick.name+'-'+ts+'.json',raw_size:Buffer.byteLength(raw,'utf8'),raw_md5:crypto.createHash('md5').update(raw).digest('hex'),image_url:img,image_name:pick.name+'-'+ts+'.png',image_key:pick.pokemon_id+'/'+pick.name+'-'+ts+'.png',report_content:csv,report_name:'rapport-'+pick.name+'-'+ts+'.csv',report_key:pick.pokemon_id+'/rapport-'+pick.name+'-'+ts+'.csv',report_size:Buffer.byteLength(csv,'utf8'),report_md5:crypto.createHash('md5').update(csv).digest('hex')}};
